DOCUMENTOS.TEXTO_PLACEHOLDER: Paste the text here (from a PDF, e-mail, manual...)
DOCUMENTOS.TEXTO_ERRO: Paste the text (up to 200 thousand characters)
DOCUMENTOS.LINK_AVISO: It reads this page and the pages linked from it on the same site — a home page link can pull the whole site. For a single text, use Paste text.

TESTAR.AJUDA: Write it the way a lead would ask. The list shows the FAQs the assistant would find, in the order it gets them.
TESTAR.PLACEHOLDER: E.g.: can I keep working while on accident benefit?
TESTAR.NADA: The assistant would not find any FAQ for this question. Consider creating one.
TESTAR.ERRO: Could not test right now. Try again.

FAQ.USADA_AJUDA: How many times the assistant used this FAQ in real conversations (Test does not count). Last time: {quando}.

SKILLS.LIGAR: Turn this skill on or off
SKILLS.LIGADA: Skill on: the assistant uses it again.
SKILLS.DESLIGADA: Skill off: the assistant stops using it.
SKILLS.EDITADA_AJUDA: Edited on screen: the automatic skill load does not change or turn off this one.
SKILLS.USO_AJUDA: How many times this skill's tools ran in real conversations in the last 30 days. Test and test cases do not count; a tool used by two skills counts in both.
SKILLS.EXEMPLO_PLACEHOLDER: E.g.: What documents are missing in this case?
SKILLS.PAPEIS_LABEL: Roles that use it most (shown first in Test)

AGENTE.SUBTITULO: Every request made to the agent in a note: what was asked, what it answered and did, and how long it took. Cost lives in Usage and cost.
AGENTE.NENHUMA_ACAO: No writes (only answered in the note).

SUGESTOES.NENHUMA_DO_TIPO: No suggestion of this kind right now.

TESTAR.CASO_AJUDA: Picking a lead adds the case number to your message.

CONFIG.SO_EQUIPE: This assistant only talks to the team: customer messages, conversation FAQs and contact memory do not apply to it.
CONFIG.MEMORIA_AJUDA: When the conversation is resolved, the AI notes on the lead (panel → Notes) what it learned: benefit of interest, work, dates, documents and objections. It never notes health data, ID numbers, phone or address. Stops on the day spending passes the cap.
CONFIG.TEXTO_FINAL: See the final text the assistant receives
CONFIG.TEXTO_FINAL_AJUDA: Guidelines, guardrails and the skill list together, the way they go to the AI, plus the text of each skill that is on. Read only.
CONFIG.TEXTO_FINAL_ERRO: Could not load the text right now.

VIGIA.NO_LIMITE: At the end of the follow-up ladder

CASO_IA.TITULO: What the AI did in this case
CASO_IA.VAZIO: The AI has not done anything in this case yet.

CADERNO.NOTURNO: Run by itself at dawn (05:30), if something changed
CADERNO.NOTURNO_AJUDA: Applies to every assistant. Runs the active cases when a skill, FAQ, setting or case changed since the last run, and skips the day spending passed the cap (Usage and cost). Estimate: {n} per run of this assistant.
